decisions.decision: Ship Turbo as an explicitly labeled UAC-elevated privileged traversal fallback instead of claiming an unimplemented USN journal accelerator.
decisions.reason: A transparent, tested fallback preserves correctness and protected-file access; reporting USN mode without FSCTL enumeration would be a false completion claim.
decisions.impact: Turbo/F5 relaunches Voidspace through UAC with the selected scope and shows TURBO FALLBACK. The typed helper protocol and embedded requireAdministrator helper remain packaged for future USN acceleration.
